detailed_description: PDF to Base64 converts a selected PDF file into Base64 text directly in the browser. Drop or choose a PDF, and the page reads it with the FileReader API, shows the file name, original size, and generated text size, then displays the result in a text area. The Data URI toggle keeps the data:application/pdf;base64, prefix when you need a full inline value, or strips it when an API, JSON field, fixture, or documentation example needs only the raw Base64 portion. This is useful for temporary test payloads, HTML prototypes, API examples, and developer notes where a text representation of a PDF is enough. The tool does not compress PDFs, remove metadata, verify signatures, decode Base64 back into a file, or upload the visible conversion to a server. Base64 output is usually about one third larger than the original PDF.
usage_steps: Click the file picker area or drop a PDF onto the upload zone.
Confirm the selected file is a PDF; other file types are rejected by the page.
Keep the Data URI toggle on when you need the data:application/pdf;base64, prefix.
Turn the toggle off when you need only the raw Base64 text after the comma.
Copy the text area output into your test payload, code sample, or documentation draft.
usage_examples: Prepare a quick JSON fixture with a PDF field for local API testing.
Paste a short Data URI into an HTML iframe example while writing documentation.
Compare the original PDF size with the generated Base64 text before sending a temporary payload.

faqs.question: Is the PDF uploaded to a server?
faqs.answer: The visible conversion runs in the browser with FileReader. Follow your own security policy before using any online tool with confidential documents.

faqs.question: What does the Data URI toggle do?
faqs.answer: When enabled, the result starts with data:application/pdf;base64,. When disabled, the output contains only the Base64 text.

faqs.question: Does this reduce PDF size?
faqs.answer: No. Base64 is an encoding, not compression, and the text output is usually about 33 percent larger than the original file.

faqs.question: Can this page decode Base64 back to PDF?
faqs.answer: No. This page only creates Base64 text from a PDF file. Use a separate decoder or project code if you need to rebuild the file.
